page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured on the x86_64 CPU architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. The hardware payload features 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 128 GB of system memory, yielding a standard ratio of 4 GB of RAM per core. Parallel processing capabilities are supplied by two integrated NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units that collectively provide 16 GB of VRAM.

Network connectivity is specified at a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps, supporting stable throughput for data transport and distributed node communication. The instance does not include local disk storage, requiring external block storage or remote storage infrastructure for data persistence. Providing twin inference-focused accelerators alongside substantial system memory delivers a cost-efficient resource profile for specialized acceleration without the capital overhead associated with heavy model training accelerators.

This hardware configuration is suited for production AI inference, automated video encoding and streaming pipelines, image processing, and general-purpose workloads that require parallel mathematical execution alongside dedicated CPU compute capacity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance based on the x86_64 architecture using the KVM hypervisor. The system provides 32 dedicated vCPUs, 128 GB of memory, and 6 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Compute acceleration is supplied by two NVIDIA P4 GPUs with 16 GB of total VRAM. The instance includes no local storage, relying on network-attached storage solutions. With a 4 GB RAM per vCPU allocation and dual inference accelerators, this instance offers a balanced resource density for parallel processing tasks. It is tailored for machine learning inference, real-time video transcoding, image analysis, and parallel computing workloads.
